{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

duplicate_count = len(duplicate_patients)
print(f'Duplicate patient IDs: {duplicate_count}')

# Check if there are any patients in control arm with moderate severity
control_moderate = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]
print(f'Control arm, moderate severity patients: {len(control_moderate)}')

# Check if responded is binary
print(f'Unique values in responded: {df['responded'].unique()}')"}
